question.text: When an investor with a registered email address has not separately asked for a physical Consolidated Account Statement (CAS), how is the CAS typically delivered?

answer.text: Electronically by email, unless the investor has specifically requested a physical CAS
Statement is only available for download on the AMC website
Physical delivery through postal mail by default
Both physical and electronic delivery simultaneously to every investor with an email

explanation.text: The Logic: Where an investor has a registered email address and has not asked for a physical CAS, the CAS is sent by email. A physical CAS is provided to investors who specifically opt for it. Statements of Account (SoA) in soft copy are sent only if so mandated by the investor; otherwise the physical SoA route can apply. The workbook also gives investors the right to opt out of receiving the CAS itself. The Trap: Providing email does not automatically duplicate everything in both modes, nor does it route every account statement only to the website. The default routing of the CAS to email applies when the investor has not requested a physical CAS. Note: The same logic does not automatically apply to every individual AMC account statement. The default SoA medium depends on whether the investor has mandated electronic delivery; the CAS-by-email default is the clear case in the workbook.
